sanskrit: cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥanekaśāstra māyādau kathitā parameśvaraanekaśāstraśravaṇādasmākaṃ bhrāmitaṃ manaḥyogastu ṣaḍvidhaḥ proktā nānātvaṃ tasya dṛśyateśāstrasya saṃgatirnāsti śaṃsayaṃ kathaya prabhodevānāṃ paramāṃ bhaktiṃ śrutvā tu paramaṃ muniḥtvayā hi kathitaṃ yat tad rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamaṃvedaśāstrasya madhye tu svāśrayogaḥ prasasyatemunayaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu yogasāmyaṃ niropitaṃhimādriśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitritegaṃgādisaritastatra sarvatīrthaniṣeviteekānte vijane gopye cittasyāhlādakārakesiddhāsane samo bhūtvā yogeṣu pariniṣṭitaḥniraṃjanaṃ nirākāraṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirūpamaṃkvacit kāle mahāmāyā śāmbhavī tatra māgatānamaste ādināthāya viśvanāthāya te namaḥnamaste viśvakandāya viśvabījāya te namaḥsṛṣṭisthitiṃ vināśānāṃ tvaṃ hetuḥ parameśvaraḥnamo rajasvarūpāya satvarūpāya te namaḥadhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ sā vidyā tvaṃ sureśvaracandrādibhya svarūpāya namaste jātavedasetrayī vidyā somapāya phaladāya guṇātmakagāyatrī caiva sāvitrī mahāmāyā sarasvatītriśūnyāya namastubhyaṃ pañcaprāṇāya te namaḥaharniśātmako bhūtvā māyācakra vyavasthitāḥ

sanskrit: namaste nādarūpāya bindurūpāya te namaḥsthulasūkṣmaprabhedena sarvatraiva vyavasthitāakārāya namastubhyaṃ ukārāya namo namaḥjñānavijñāna guhyātmā kūṭasthaḥ kūṭavarjitaḥṛgyajuḥ sāmarūpāya namaste mantrarūpiṇesākārosinirākāro dehasthaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥsvayaṃ jyoti paramātmā ekopi bahudhā sthitaḥsarvajñāna namastestu namaste sarvagāya casajīvastvaṃ guṇādhīno māyayā hyaṃtravāhakaḥsarvatatvāṃtarasthāya caitanyāya namastutetvayā vinānakopyasti phalado karmakāriṇaṃakṣarāya namastubhyaṃ mapamṛtyuvināsinesarveṣāṃ caiva yajñānāṃ tvaṃ ca deva mahāmalaḥakartātvamudāsīno sādhanodharmarakṣakaḥrasarūpa svarūpāya namaste gandharūpiṇeuttamaḥ puruṣaḥ tvanya paramātmā jagatpatiḥpañcabhūtātmane śambho namaste tatva vigrahaḥdvaitādvaitasvarūpāya namaste bhedavarjitekartā hartā prabhuḥ sākṣī bhartābhoktā maheśvaraḥgaṃgādhara namastubhyaṃ namaste candramaulinesiddhavidyādharāścānye tvadīśāḥ sarvadevatāḥnamo viśvaprabodhāya jñānabodhāya te namaḥkarmasaṃvalitaṃ tasya trātātvaṃ parameśvarayogānmukti prado deva bhavakarmopadeśataḥsarvādhāro nirādhāro jagatāṃ sūtradhārakaḥ

sanskrit: bhavormi vyākulaṃ deva raktamāṃsaraṇāgatāṃārtānāmārtihaṃtātvaṃ kṛpādṛṣṭvāvalokayaśakteḥ śivasya ca paraṃ yastvaṃ brahma niraṃtaraṃdhyānāduparatacitta stutyā jāto maheśvaramahādevaṃ namaskṛtya tayāpraśna ayaṃkṛtaḥśāstre tvanantaḥ paṃthānaḥ karmabhināḥ śrutā mayātasmāt kathaya sarvajña kāraṇaṃ vedaśāstrayoḥṣaṭ darśane vivādaśca vitarko manasi sthitaḥyogaścaikaḥ sarvasāstre procyate kimanekadhākathayasva mahādeva praśnamanyaṃ yathārthataḥparamātmā ca nirguṇaḥ jīva sākṣī tu kaḥ prabhojīvasya brahmasaṃyogaḥ kenopāyena jāyatetayostaṃbho bhavet kena upāyena surādhipaḥkṛpayā lokya netrābhyāṃ pārvatīṃ samuvācahasṛṣṭyarthaṃ kalpito bhedo na bhedaḥ paramārthataḥyogamārgeṇa mokṣosti sa yoga śivajīvayoḥnānātvaṃ nāsti yogasya nāmnā bhedaḥ prakalpayettairebhidhānairyogasya tvattasarve bruvanti hiāgamādyāni śāstrāṇi jñānaṃ nāsti guruṃ vināyogajñānaṃ sphuṭaṃ tasmai bruvate nātrasaṃsayaḥdaivena darśanaṃ tasya jāyante jñānatodhikānsaṃvibhāvyātma yogasya dvādaśāddhāni sundarīdhyānaṃ samādhiretāni yogāṃgāni mahātapetatpraveśe smṛtaṃ bhadre tvakṣare deha pūrakeniścalaṃ nābhi deśī ca sarvapāpapranāśanaṃ

sanskrit: graṃtthi bhedādike nātha manoviṣayanāśanaṃsudhāmayaṃ mahāsaumyaṃ kavitvaṃ yena jāyateaṣṭasiddhi pradaṃ puṃsāṃ yogasyāṃga prakīrtitaṃsamādhīriti vikhyātaṃ sarvajñānāvabhāsakaṃyathābrahma yathāyogo durlakṣastridaśairapivahavo yoginaḥ siddhā aṃgairetairvarānanepratyāhāro rudrabhāvo dhāraṇā ceśvare matābhāvāne tān samabhyasya yogī brahmaṇyavasthitaprāṇasyārddha pracāreṇa sarveṣāṃ caiva saṃmatāṃśruṇutvaṃ vyāpakaṃ brahma dattacittāvadhānataḥsa jīvaḥ procyate sadbhi kriyāyukto hṛdisthitaḥvinirmitaṃ tayā sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamaṃcandrasūryāgni madhyasthā sā ca jīva svarūpinīpāśavaddho yadā jīvaḥ pāśamuktaḥ śadāśivaḥasaṃsati phale yuktaḥ sarvabhūtavyavasthitaḥtadā saṃjñāṃ parityaktvā svayaṃ brahmaṃ bhaveditiniścalaṃ śuddhasatvaṃ ca tasya jñānādvimucyatemanaḥprāṇasamāyogaḥ praṇavena vinā na hipraṇavaḥ procyate sadbhiḥ prāṇāyāmatrayātmakaḥāsanādi kramenaiva śanairyogī samabhyasetyogābhyāsarato nityaṃ yogī brahmasamo bhavetvāmadakṣiṇakaṃ tyaktā prāṇamūle samabhyasetantarnāḍī pracāreṇa jīvaḥ śivamayo bhavetpāśacchedaḥ prakartavyaḥ prāṇāyāmaika yogataḥjñātvā yogavidhiṃ samyak dvayoraikyaṃ samabhyaset

sanskrit: adya me saphalaṃ jñānaṃ tvatprasādā bhavāntakaniddhāraṃ na ca vai tasya saṃsayo vartate mamamanovasthācatuṣkaṃ ca dharmādharmavicāraṇaṃkīdṛśaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva bhāvābhāvau tathaiva casahajaṃ ca yathājñānaṃ kathayāmi sureśvarakrameṇa kathayiṣyāmi śṛtvātvaṃ hṛdi dhārayatat te karma pravakṣyāmi yat jñātvā mokṣase'śubhātakarmaṇaśca boddhavyaṃ gahaṇākarmaṇo gatiḥkṣarākṣaravinirmuktaṃ vikarma pratipadyatekarmasītāṃśunirdiṣṭaṃ prāṇo caiva pratiṣṭhitaṃete bhedāḥ samākhyātā karmākarmavikarmajāḥsa buddhimānmanuṣyeṣu sayuktaḥ kṛtsna karmakṛtatha kandaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūlaṃ vai sarvakāraṇaṃkarmākarmavicāroyaṃ guhya eva udāhṛtāḥsomasūrya havistatra śaktiḥ svāheti mantritaṃdaśadhātu samopetaṃ paṃcatanmātravarjitaṃvināyena mṛtaṃ manye taṃ kandaṃ dehasaṃsthitaṃvidyāpīṭhaṃ bhavet tasya mudrāmaṇḍalameva cakandamūlamidaṃ bhadre śubhāśubhamathaśruṇuśubhāśubhataraṃ viddhi sāśvataṃ brahmaṇo mataṃjāgrasvapnasuṣuptiśca turyāvasthāna bhedataḥtālumadhye tṛtīyā tu caturthā vyomarandhrakedeheṣvavasthitāḥ sarvāḥ vṛttibhedānmanomayāḥprathame saṃpravakṣyāmi dharmādharmasya lakṣaṇaṃagniṣomātmakau viddhi ahorātri svarūpakau

sanskrit: sūryacandramasau jñeyau sthirāsthiraparāparaudvāsuparṇī vimaujīvau paṭhyate vedaśāstrayoḥiḍānaṃ piṃgalanāmākhyau jāhnavī yamuneticaunānāvidhānasaṃjñātau dharmādharmapratisthitauasaṃjñaṃ tu paraṃ brahma saṃjñājīvaśvarūpinīṃhariharāvana dvau dvau sarvadehe vyavasthitaurāgādi mālīne kāye yenātmānaṃ prapatsyateprekṣiṇa sākṣiṇaṃ nityaṃ bhāṣate paramaśva saḥathānyaṃ paramaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu bhedaṃ tṛtīyakaṃstrīpuṃnapuṃsakaṃ jñeyastamaḥ satvotha rājasaḥsa eva jīva uddiśaḥ saṃsārī cetano mataḥekopi bahudhā bhinnastatve tatva vyavasthitaḥdharmādharmātmako vandho jīvasya parikīrtitaḥevaṃ saṃsārabandhosau kālacakre pratisthitaḥdharmādharmavinirmuktaṃ yadi cittaṃ nirāśrayaṃcittaṃ jīvitamākhyātamacitte maraṇaṃ dhruvaṃjīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ mayābhavaḥ praveśamātreṇa nirgamo bhāvasaṃjñakaḥbhāvaḥ prāṇasamākhyātaṃ abhayoyana śabditaḥśūnyaṃ sarvanirābhāsaṃ svarūpaṃ yatra cinyatelayayogo haṭhaścaiva mantrayogastṛtīyakaḥkṣetrajñaḥ paramātmā ca dvayoraikyaṃ kathaṃ bhavethakāraṃ sūryasaṃjñaṃ tu ṭhakāraṃ candrarūpiṇaṃmakāreṇa manaḥ proktaṃ trakāraṃ prāṇa ucyateapānavṛttimākṛṣya prāṇogacchati madhyame

sanskrit: indraḥ sakāraṃ saṃjño yo hakāraḥ kathyate raviḥnāmnāmatāntare bhedo na bhedaḥ paramārthataḥsarvabhāvavinirmuktaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ brahmaṇi nyasetetat jñānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ ca śeṣonyograṃthavistaraḥnāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥyogagamyaṃ paraṃ brahma ityalīkavaca prabhotatvārthaṃ vadate nātha yathāveda pratisthitaṃkenopāyena tatprāpya yatpadaṃ parikīrtitaṃavarṇamasvaraṃ brahma kathaṃ dhyānaṃ niyoginaḥśrutyarthaḥ kīdṛśaḥ śaṃbho sphuṭī kuru jaṭādharaḥbindupātaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ grasāḥ ke caturāśrameamūrti bhāvanā yātu yathārthaṃ pravadāmyahaṃbindupātaṃ ca grāsāśca śṛṇucchindhi yathākramaṃnānāpathasamākhyātau sevyate yogibhiḥ sadāyena mārgena gantavyaṃ brahmasthānaṃ nirāmayaṃna gacchat punarāvṛttiṃ tarate bhavasāgaraṃtena sarve durācārā śāstranirddhāravarjitaḥkiṃ kāraṇaṃ mahādevī viṣṇumāyā vimohitāḥna smaraṃti paraṃ tatva sanān saṃgavivarjayetprathame śakti nirdhāraṃ na kāraṃ sa dvitīyakena jānanti paraṃ bhāvaṃ devasya parameśvarīidaṃ tu paramaṃ tatvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ jñānacakṣuṣātasmāt sarvaprayatnena prāṇāyāmaṃ samabhyasetādhārasaṃsthitaṃ tāvat yāvad brahma layaṃgataḥte pataṃti mahāghore raurave nātrasaṃsayaḥ

sanskrit: anyathā niścaye nāsti karuṇāṃ kurune prabhokṛpāṃ kuruṣva me nātha saṃśaya chedakārakaḥagnidhūmātmakaḥ paṃthā uttaraṃ dakṣiṇāyanaṃagnidhūmasvarūpaṃ tu vyaktaṃ kuru maheśvaraviṣuvaṃ sūryarūpaṃ ca madhyasthaḥ bhavamocakaṃanyacca guhyasaṃketaṃ yadyasti kathayasva meādhyātmikaṃ svabhavasthaṃ gītaśāstreṣu saṃsmṛtaṃtatra prayātā gacchanti brahmabrahmavidojanaḥyatra cāndrasamaṃ hyotiryogī prāpya nivartatepralayaṃ * tyunā yuktā bhrāmitā viṣṇu māyayāīḍāpiṃgalanāmākhyau prāṇāpānapravāhakauekasya āśrayaṃ brahma dvitīyasya prabhāśrayaḥanyonya gati saṃcārāt saṃkrāntī savīdhiyateagnirjyotirahaḥśuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsādakṣiṇāyanaṃyogatastena mārgeṇa pataṃti bhavasāgareekayāyātpanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥsatye ca yāmya digbhāge jñātavyamayana dvayaṃdullabhaṃ tatra saṃsāramavidyā kṛṣṇa cetasāṃekaśvāsau dvidhābhūta chāyāvṛkṣa ivasthitaḥprāṇāpāṇau tathā bhadre dehamadhye vyavasthitautathāpi śṛṇu kartārau prāṇāpāṇau smṛtā vubhauubhābhyāṃ piṇḍaniṣpatti jāyate sthiti saṃhṛdiparabrahmaṇajīvoyaṃ sāyujyaṃ prāpyate dhruvaṃagnidhūmātmakaḥ paṃthā kathitaḥ sopapattikaḥapunarbhavadaṃ puṇyaṃ sugopyaṃ kathayāmyahaṃ

sanskrit: prāṇāpānagatirurddhā prāṇāpānaparāyanaḥsarvepyate yajñavido yajña kṣapiti kalmaśāsvāhoccārita mantreṇa hutvā yajñaḥ prakīrtitaḥdeha sthite rogajarāpahāraṃ mokṣasya sāraṃ munayo vadantīviṣuvantaṃ vijānīyād bhāvābhāvavivarjitaṃhaṃsasya parameśasya pakṣai vyāptaṃ carācaraṃdve pakṣe gatisaṃsasya adhorddha vāmadakṣiṇesṛṣṭisaṃhārako haṃso yena viśvaṃ pragopitaṃguroḥ pādaprasādena jñātavyaṃ tu vicāraṇeatha pramāṇayogena brute sarvaṃ śubhāśubhaṃvātadvayasamāhārāddhaṃso niścalatāṃ gataḥdehamuktimavāpnoti khecaro jāyate naraḥviṣuvaṃ sādhayet tasmād vairāgyena parena tuviṣuvantaṃ vijānīyāt āyuṣyaṃ phaladāyakaṃsādhanaṃ viṣuvaṃ sādhyaṃ varddhanaṃ puṇyakarmaṇāṃsā sandhyā kulaniṣṭānāṃ viṣuvaṃ parikīrtitaṃviṣuvena vinā nāsti tasmādviṣumavāśrayetdharmārthakāmamokṣyāṇāṃ viṣuvaṃ suprasiddhidaṃprāṇatrayaṃ cakṣutrayaṃ tathā vai manasatrayaṃlokatrayaṃ trikālaṃ ca trivedamakṣaratrayaṃvedatrayaṃ tribhāstu guṇatrayamudāhṛtaṃbindutrayaṃ trivaktraṃ ca trikūṭaṃ śikharatrayaṃavasthā tritayaṃ sthānaṃ taṃtevīṣuvamucyatepuṇyane labhate jñānaṃ nānyapyādarśanaṃ bhavetprāṇasaṃyamane puṇyaṃ nirguṇaṃ mokṣakāraṇaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣuvaṃ praṇavajñānaṃ smaratvaṃ dehamadhyataṃtat jñāne tatkṣaṇāt siddhi jāyate nātrasaṃsayaḥye kecid devatāścānye indrādyā ṛṣayastathāsiddhividyā dharāścaiva svedajā udvijāstathāpraṇavaṃ ca parityaktvā yonyamaṃtramupāsatekriyā nāsti karmayogo nāsti mantrān cintanaṃanantanāmaparyāyaistārakaṃ parikīrtitaṃetatsarvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ hṛdaye paribhāvayacaturthaḥ paṭalaḥātmanaḥ pratikūlāni pareṣāṃ na samācaretpareṣu ca ti sarvāni pare cendrādaya smṛtaḥtāmasā rājasāścaiva sātvikā trividhā smṛtaḥdehād dehāntaraṃ gatvā ajñānāvṛtacetasaḥhṛdi kleśāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti sa eva jāyate śivaḥjanmamṛtyujarāśoka bhayaduḥkhaṃ tadā na hisa coddeśaḥ guṇā prokto guṇakarmāni bhāvayetguṇapravāhe bhavabandhanaṃ syāt aguṇa pravāhebandhasya mokṣasya guṇeṣu kāryaṃ saṃtāpe bhedena adhorddhavṛrttitadā vandhasya vijñeyaḥ karmalakṣaṇasaṃjñakaḥtadā muktirna saṃdeha piṇḍasya patanaṃ na himāyā ānavakarmākhya guṇabrahmaṇi saṃsthitaḥguroḥ pādaprasādena teṣāṃ siddhiradūrataḥtvat praśnaṃ kathitaṃ devī paramārtha phalapradaṃsarveṣāṃ caiva vākyānāṃ brahmaṇaiva samanvayaḥjñānātmakaṃ sarvaharaṃ yogenānandadāyakaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekaṃ ca brahmabhedena prakārai nāmayogataḥānandamamṛtaṃ brahma cintayasva suniścalaṃpaṃcamaḥ paṭalaḥbrahmavate na gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhināsthūlaṃ saguṇamākhyātaṃ sūkṣmaṃ saguṇanirguṇaṃtadvaśīhavihutvā kuru brahmārpaṇaṃ priyegṛhītvā tu pareṇaiva sūkṣmaṃ tadbrahmaṇāhutaṃbrahmavate na gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhināarjunasya prabodhāya dvāparānte mahāhavebhaktiyogakriyādānaṃ sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇe sthitaṃbrahmakarmasamāyogā darpaṇasyānna cānyathāpāpakṣayakaraṃ bhadre kaivalyaṃ phaladāyakaṃkarmagrastā na jānanti karmakālātmakaṃ manaḥāśrayed yoga satkarma manobhāvavivarjitaṃbrahmavidyātmakaṃ jñānaṃ brahmadhyānamiti smṛtaṃte sarve brahmasaṃbhūtā tasmād brahma vicintayetekakālaṃ paraṃ daivaṃ kecit kāmamutā pareudāsīnaśca idhyakṣo vāyurātmani dehināṃsṛjatpatti punaḥ pāti svaśaktyā mayayā yutaḥceṣṭate yena viśvaṃ ca yenedaṃ rakṣitaṃ sadāghoṣā idasya śṛṇi varena rūpaṃ tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhemāpratyakṣaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dṛśyate na ca labhyateyena brahmādayo devāḥ pālitā svātma māyayāprāpnuyādyoga mārgeṇa śāstreṇa tasmādyogaṃ samabhyasetvahvācāya pravādaistu śāstrabhedaḥ pradṛśyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa yogaḥ kīrtito vede prāṇāpānasamāgamātetacchāstrasya sadbhāvaṃ nānyathā mokṣasādhanaṃyogino munayaścaiva tataḥ prāṇa niyantrayetprāṇāyāmaṃ vinābhadra yogināṃ hi viṭaṃbhanāantanāḍī pracāreṇa brahmārpaṇa bhaveditijīvanmukto bhaved yogī khecaro jāyate svayaṃṣaṭcakra bhedanād devī konasiddhyati bhūtaleīśvarapārvatīsaṃvāde ṣaṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥadhunoktaṃ tvayā deva ṣaṭcakraṃ te kimātmakaṃkenopāyena deveśa vaktumarhasya śeṣataḥādhāraśca sa vijñeya svakarmaṇi * saṃsthitaḥarṇāśramocitaṃ karma tasmāt taṃ tatyajet kvacitkṛtvā haṃtā parityāgaṃ jñātvā karma samācaretpādaprakṣālanaṃ caiva kṛtvā camya vidhānataḥkṛtvā taddhārayed vastraṃ tautaṃ malavivarjitaṃkuryāt sūryodaye saṃdhyā kālaṃ naiva ca laṃghayetkālocitaṃ prakurvīta kāryakāraṇasaṃjñakaṃbrahmajñānaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca tadevamokṣasādhakaḥtasya vighnasahaśrāṇi saṃbhavanti na saṃsayaḥtayā buddhyādurācārā patate niraye dhruvaṃyogīsvarastute vijñe anye tena madhārakāḥekādaśīvrataṃ dāna śaktyā ca śivapūjanaṃtīrthasevā nirmalatvamasteyama pratīgrahaḥnidrālasya parityāgaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca varjayetgurusuśrūṣaṇaṃ caiva saujanyaṃ guruvāndhavai
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: indrayārtheṣu vairāgyametadyogasya sādhanaṃvairāgya na matiryoge bhavate bhavavarjiteyasya prasādāt paraṃ yoga jñānaṃ ca labhyatekarmaṇā jāyate yogaḥ kathaṃ karma parityajetyogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyateyogābhyāsaḥ prakartavyaḥ sthāne ca nirupadraveguhāyā puṇyadeśe tu devatāyatanepi vākalpanā kalpite puṇye dhyānasiddhiḥ prajāyatesudhūpa dhūpitaṃ kṛtvā tatra yogaṃ samabhyasetgurupādāmbujaṃ natvā māṃ ca dhyātvā sadāśivaṃniṣedhavarjitaṃ saumyaṃ cittasyā hlādakārakaṃtatra siddhāsanaṃ vaddhvā rajukāyaṃ ca dhārayetgurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ samabhyasetrecayed vai dakṣiṇayātayāpi saṃprapūrayetevamabhyāsayogena nāḍī śuddhi prajāyateyatheṣṭadhāraṇaṃ vāyornāḍī śuddhā ca labhyatetasmāt sarva prayatnena kartavyaṃ nāḍi śodhanaṃcandrasūryadvayormadhye cintayet parameśvaraṃsuṣumnāntargataṃ devaṃ bhāvagamyaṃ sadāśivaṃṣaṭcakra bhedanāt samyak nānyathā bhāvagocaraṃsamāno maṇipūraṃ ca udāno nāhataṃ smṛtaṃṣaṣṭamambujasaṃsthaṃ ca vyomarūpamudāhṛtaṃtayā sarvāṇi cakrāṇi bhāvyaṃte dehamadhyataḥṣaṭdalaṃ caturaṃ caiva ṣaṭcakraṃ mātṛkodbhavaṃprāṇacakre valāṃ sāni akṣarāṇi śuśobhane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṭhāntā dvādaśā proktā udānacakramāśritāḥvyomacakre sthitau dvau tu haṃsaprāṇasvarūpakauprāṇāpāna dvayorgraṃthiḥ praveśe nirgame sthitaḥṣaṭcakraṃ kīrtitaṃ devī yena vaṃdhaḥ prajāyatebhidyate prāṇacakreṇa prāṇacakraṃ śivātmakaṃtasmāt ṣaṭcakra bhedena yogī brahma padaṃ vrajetapānasaṃsthitaṃ cakramādhāraṃ sūryasaṃjñakaṃsamāne tu tṛtīyena samānojātavedasetaṃ nābhi maṃḍale cakre procyate maṇi pūrakaṃanāhata bhudānākhyaṃ cakraṃ cāntarasaṃsthitaṃājñācakraṃ tu ṣaṣṭaṃ vai vyomarūpamudāhṛtaṃṣaṭcakrabhedataḥ prāṇo nānyosti cakra bhedakaḥdaśāraṃ maṇipūraṃ ca dvādaśāramanāhataṃṣaṭcakraṃ prāṇamuddiśyaṃ prāṇopānena bhidyateprāṇacakrasvarūpo hi svayuṃbhettābhavet tu saḥsarvasaṃsārikaṃ cakraṃ prāṇādeva prajāyateprāṇaḥ sarvagataṃ brahma sarvaṃ prāṇe pratiṣṭhitaṃkaivalyaṃ śāsvataṃ brahma iti vedavido vruvanbrahmajñānaparaṃ devī samūḍharakṣitaṃ mayātāvat karma prabhāvoyaṃ yāvadātmāna vidyatedevānāṃ durlabhaṃ tatva mayopyeṣu na dāpayetstrīlaṃpaṭā durācārā kṛtaghnā vakavṛttayaḥkrodhino hiṃsakāścaiva dāṃbhikāḥ piśunāstathādravyalubdhāḥ śaṭhāmūrtāḥ karkaśāḥ kalahapriyāhetukā vādinaścaiva teṣāṃ jñānaṃ pragopayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāpiṣṭaṃ tadviyānīyāt dūrataḥ parivarjayetguṇapravāhe patito naṣṭaprajño vrajatyadhaḥeteṣu jñānasarvasvaṃ na deyaṃ paramārthataḥśiṣyasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñātvā ātmajñānaṃ pradāpayetpurāsatya yuge devī viśuddha tamayokhilāḥātmajñānaprabhāveṇa vedābhyāsarato naraḥtasmin kālo jagatprāṇo mama pratyakṣatāṃ gatāḥsvāgamaiḥ kalpitaistvaṃ ca jananmadvimukhāṃ kuruityāha paramātmā sā vadṛśo jāyate svayaṃbhūtavṛddistathā jātā svātmajñānaṃ vinā priyeyasya jñānamidaṃ loke sa śivo nararūpadhṛkyasya nāsti paraṃ jñānaṃ sa vai pāpādhikodhamaḥayamātmā paronantaḥ pratyakṣo vyomavigrahaḥna hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyatevedārthasārasarvasvaṃ sarvaśāstraika vākyataḥsaptamaḥ paṭalaḥkathitaṃ tatva sadbhāvaṃ brahmajñānaṃ sugopitaṃagnisomagatirbhaṅgyacchivadīkṣāratāpavauvāca śāśvataṃ rudraṃ vismitā bhālalocanāyā dīkṣā yogamadhyasthā na jānāti maheśvaraḥprasanno bhavadeveśa dīkṣāṃ kathaya śaṃkaraḥdānakṣālanasaṃyogād dīkṣetyātmā pracakṣatetṛtīyā śāmbhavī jñeyā bheda eva tridhoditaḥhrasva brahmani vikhyātā mantreṇaiva pratisthitādvimātrā trayasaṃyuktā trimātrācaturaṃnvitāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthūlasūkṣmapareṇaiva praṇavena sunirmitaṃūrddhena bodhitaṃ tatvaṃ adhaḥ saṃjñaṃ śivātmakaṃkuṇḍalīyarabhaṃtasvaṃ? ūrddhaṃ tena suvedhitaṃtasyorddhaṃ vyāpakatvaṃ ca ūrddhaṃ tena suvedhitaṃprathame saṃsthite brahmā dvitīye viṣṇureva caekaṃ caiva tridhā bhūtaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ sthityantakārakaṃrecakaṃ śāṃbhavī bodhā kuṃbhakaṃ śaktisaṃyutaṃmantravedhaṃ śaktivedhaṃ śāṃbhavī vedhamucyatepaścimābhimukhaṃ liṃgaṃ manaḥsūkṣmaṃ prajāyatemanasaṃ vaṃdhitaṃ tena liṃgena vahnimaṇḍiteguṇatrayavinirmuktaṃ manaścorddha gataṃ bhavettadā sā śāṃbhavī dīkṣā tāṃ vidyājjālakṛṃtinīevaṃ dīkṣā mayākhyātā triḥsvarūpā svabhāvajāanye pratārakāviddhi śiśnodara parāyaṇāḥavidyāviṣṭa cittānāṃ tādṛśī vādhyate matiḥgurorvilokanād devi siṣye vedhaḥ prajāyateiti matvā kriyāśaktyā vartate kapi ceṣṭayāyajñamantreṣu yā dīkṣā sā dīkṣā naivamokṣadāmantra yantrāḥ śaktipādo sā dīkṣānopapadyatekā dīkṣā śāmbhavī vedhā na vindaṃtyāṇavī tathāātmānaṃ ḍaṃbhitaṃ taistu daṃbhayanti punaḥ punaḥna budhyaṃtya kulaṃ kaulāḥ karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ tathādehamātmeti manyante viṣayāhṛṣṭacetasāpratyakṣepi na jānanti mohitā mama māyayādīkṣājñānaṃ bhavet teṣāṃ satsaṃgenahyakaulikaṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāptavyā gurukāruṇyāt dīkṣā hyādhyātmikī parānāsti dīkṣā samaṃ puṇyaṃ nāsti dīkṣā samaṃ tapaḥyo vai yogastu sā dīkṣā yā dīkṣā kathitā mayādīkṣākathanaṃ nāma aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥanukrāmāṃ kramo nāsti pratyayo dṛśyate prabhoāśramādāśramaprāptiḥ kathayasva śureśvaratatkarmayogamadhye tu kiṃ vāhyaṃ vada śaṃkaradvitīyaṃ caiva garhasthaṃ vanavāsa tṛtīyakaṃko haṃsaḥ paramohaṃsaḥ triḍaṃḍīkaśca daṃḍadhṛkvicāraḥ kīdṛśastasya yena mokṣaḥ prajāyatetatvato brūhi me nātha kṛpāṃ kuru maheśvarasvarūpaṃ sa guṇaṃ cātra nirguṇaṃ ca sadāśivatathā brahmamayaṃ deva kiṃ cānyat parikīrtitaṃkīdṛśī dhāraṇā sā tu procyate vṛṣabhadhvajaḥkodhikārī varṇamadhye ko mantraḥ kasya pūjanaṃuttaraṃ dehi sarvajñaṃ satyamajñāna mocakaṃajñānatamasohaṃtā jñānadīpa namastutegarbhavāsa bhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ asahyaṃ chettu marhasiniścayaṃ kuru me nātha kathayaṃ va mocanaṃtasya kartāramapi māṃ viddhya kartāramavyayaṃcatvāro vedavarṇāśca āśramāścastathaiva caāśramādāśramaṃ gacche deṣadharmasanātanāna jānanti paraṃ dharmaṃ yena mokṣa prajāyateguṇāśrame sthito devī kathaṃ nirguṇatāṃ vrajetyadyāśrame kriyā lupto āśramī narakaṃ vrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ata cetatva buddhiryā tayā sarve vimohitāātmānaṃ vaṃcayetyete karmavāsanayā dhruvaṃantaraṃgāḥ śramā devī kathyante śāstramadhyataḥtārakasya ca madhyasthā procyante tṛpti saṃsthitāniraṃjanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu caturthaṃ tu nirālayaṃbāṇaprasthastṛtīyantu caturthaṃ yatirucyateāśramī vāhya veṣaistu mithyāhaṃkāramāśritāvānaprastha karmadaṇḍī jñānadaṇḍī yatirbhavetyenaite niyatā daṃḍā sastridaṇḍī vyavasthitaḥyadvāhya vihitaṃ karma naiṣkarmaṇi samācaretsa kaṣāyo jñānadaṇḍī naiṣkarmyaṃ kevalaṃ carettena daṇḍena saṃnyāsī ekadaṇḍīti gīyatesa śikhīmucyate vidvān itare kośa dhāriṇaḥdhāraṇāt tasya sūtrasya nocchiṣṭonośucirbhavettena sarvamidaṃ proktaṃ sūtremaṇi gaṇā ivacarati brahmabhāveṇa brahmacārī sa ucyateindriyāṇi paśūn hatvā yo yajet sa ca dīkṣitākandarpya vanamadhyastho vānaprastha sa ucyatehaṃsa ekaḥ samākhyātaḥ parahaṃsaḥ savaiśrutaḥtadbrahmāhamiti dhyātvā kathaṃ varṇāśramī bhavetparahaṃsaḥ dṛḍhajñānaḥ svacchando vigatajvalaḥvāmadakṣiṇamārgeṇa caṃcalatva na viśrametparahaṃsaḥ sthito dvaitastadāsau tanmayo bhavetteṣāṃ haṃsaḥ parāddhaṃso na dṛṣṭaḥ śāstramadhyataḥhaṃsasya darśanaṃ nāsti parahaṃsaḥ katha bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāyogān mahāvākyāt procyate tatva cintakaiḥtad vākyaṃ haṃsarūpaṃ hi sarvabhūtavyavasthitaṃmahāvākya vicārasya nāmārthaṃ pravadāmyahaṃsarvasaṃjñaṃ visaṃjñaṃ ca nānāvākyaṃtarasthitaṃmahāvākyavicāroyaṃ ṛgyajusāmamadhyataḥte vai saṃnyāsinaḥ proktoḥ itare nāmadhārakāḥsaṃnyāsalakṣaṇa sarvaṃ vidhivaddehasaṃmataṃsarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhustyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥyajñadānatapaḥ karma na tyājyamiti cāpareeteṣāṃ saṃmataṃ caikaṃ bhedo nāmnā tu dṛsyatevedeṣu sarvasāstreṣu nāsti bhadre pṛthak mataṃsaṃnyāsa lakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ yathāvat kathayāmitekāmyakarmāṇitā nyāhu yaistu dehopalabhyateutpatti sthiti saṃhāre kāraṇāste maheśvarīsaṃnyāsaḥ paramo hyeṣa anyeṣāṃ ca mataṃ śruṇutatkarmamānasaṃ proktaṃ rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ ca yattatphalaṃ brahmamārgeṇa tyaktvā tyāga prakīrtitaṃidaṃ suniścitaṃ devī hariṇācārjunasya cayajñadānatapaḥ karma na tyājyamiti cāpareyajñakarmapravese tu kuṃbhake dānakarma caetat sarvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ kāmyakarmādikaṃ priyebrahmacārī sūdadohā sūdadohāśca dīkṣitāḥdaśāre brahmacārī ca dvādaśāre gṛhī tathāśarīrasyāśramo nāsti sūdadohāśramī bhavetsarvāśramasthitaḥ sopi svakriyocittakarmaṇāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūdadohāḥ prasiddhoyaṃ ṛgvede viddhi pārvativijñātaḥ puruṣohaṃsaḥ kṣetrajño dehadhārakaḥsūdadohāparaṃ brahma paramātma svayaṃ hariḥsopi māyā svarūpeṇa nānāyoni gata prabhuḥnirguṇopi guṇādhīno māyayā śṛṣṭi hetukaḥsaguṇopi guṇātītastvabhyāsād bhavate tu saḥniyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ saṃprapadyatetasmādādhārayogena sūdadohāḥ praśasyatekecijjānanti tatvajñāḥ saṃnyāsadharmamāśritāhṛdaye granthi bhedena guṇātīto yadā bhavetkaṣāya vasanaścaiva saṃnyāsī daṇḍadhāraṇātvāhyaliṃgo na mokṣasti vāntaraṃmuktidaṃ smṛtaṃvāgmanaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca tridaṇḍī puruṣo bhavetjīvanārthaṃ ca tadvaiṇaṃ śarīre mukti sādhanaṃavyakta liṃgo vicared yogā hyāsaparoyatiḥsa saṃnyāsī na vaktavyaḥ saṃnyāsī yogatatparaḥsadāśiva parohaṃso jñānajñeyati vismṛtāḥgrahasthovānaprastho vā yatiryogādvinā na hiāśramasya phalaṃ muktiḥ karmaṇānopapadyatetatkarmasvātmarūpaṃ hi yoginaparyupāsateyadyapi syānnirākṣepaṃ tadvyāpi phaladaṃ bhavetkarmaṇā phala bhoktavyaṃ brahmādīnāṃ kṛtaṃ sphuṭaṃsaṃsārataruśākhāstu varddhate tena karmaṇāḥmanyante mandasatayaḥ pravartanteva bhaktibhiḥśāstrābhimāninaḥ kecit kecit tīrthābhamāninaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtābhimāninaḥ kecit kecinnāmābhimāninaḥtapobhimāninaḥ kecit keciddānābhimāninaḥyogamārgaṃ na jānanti yena siddhāḥ śivaṃ gatāḥpravṛtyā ca nivṛtyā ca dvaitantadguṇavaddhitaṃtasmādduḥkhaṃ sarvanidaṃ karmatyājyaṃ mataṃ budhaiḥna smaraṃti paraṃ tatvamavidyāśavalīyasīyogaṃ tyaktvānya dharmeṣu pravṛttirjāyate nṛṇāṃdaiva hīnāstute martyāḥ sukhopāyaṃ na vindatīutpattisthitisaṃhārā nasyante jñānayogataḥyasmin brahmaṇi saṃlīnaṃ anāyāsena vai dhruvaṃdurācārāḥ sa pāpiṣṭo dānte narakaṃ vrajetdharmātmā puṇyakīrtiśca sa narodeva pūjitaḥsiddhiyonasasāyujyamasiddhena surālayaṃśrūyatāṃ śraddhayā devī samāsena vadāmyahaṃsucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭobhijāyateetaddhi durlabhararaṃ loke janmayadīdṛśaṃyatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandanastutvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ yoge dṛḍhamatistadātasya mukti na saṃdehaḥ sāyujyaṃ labhate priyeyayāsandhārito yogī svakukṣau jñānavarddhanaḥyena sā vijitā loke sa dhanyaḥ puruṣo mataḥjñānaṃ parama ṇirvāṇaṃ sa naraḥ svātma bhāvayetsarvāśramaphalaṃ tasya yogasya hṛdisaṃsthitaḥdharmātmopi vijñeyo yogābhyāsarato muniḥtepi muktiṃ prāpnuvanti procyate śruti madhyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajanaṃ yājanaṃ puṇyaṃ purāṇādhyayanaṃ tathāṣaṭkarma sādhanaṃ muktiḥ satyaṃ tatkathayāmitemaṇipūre cādhyayanaṃ madhyāpanamanāhateidaṃ tu niścitaṃ devi karmamokṣāya yatpriyebuddhināśo mānuṣāṇāṃ jāyate tena karmaṇāḥbrāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdraiḥ cānye striyādibhiḥvarṇānāmāśramānāṃ ca sevyaṃ brahmasanātanaṃprathamaṃ sādhanaṃ cātra satāṃsaṃgaḥ prakathyatesaṃsāraṃ patitānāṃ ca satsaṃgo hyupa kṛnnṛṇāṃtasmāt saṃgaḥ prakartavyaḥ sātvikai mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥkasthamamṛtaṃ tyaktvā bhikṣāmaṭasidurmatiḥbrahmajñānaṃ gurorāsyāṃ prāpyate yannivartakaṃgopitaṃ sarvatantreṣu karmavistāra hetaveye ca karma rathārūḍhāste gacchanti bhavārṇaveyadi tadviguṇaṃ karma bhavate narakāya cayadi bhraṣṭo bhaved yogād brahmādīnāṃ padaṃ labhetyogasyācaraṇaṃ nūnaṃ sulabhaṃ sukhadaṃ priyeaprasannā mahāmāyā kuṇḍalī yā harestanūjaghanyaḥ sopi vijñeyo yo vai yoga nirākṛtaḥdurācārāśca te martyāḥ sadācārepi saṃsthitāsocyutaḥ prāpyate devi yogābhyāsena nānyathāphalamāśramiṇāṃ yogo muktisteṣāṃ gati smṛtāḥyogaprāpti kutasteṣāmajñānāvṛtacetasāṃhitvārcāṃ bhajate mokhyād bhasmanyeva juhoti saḥtamavajñāya māṃ martya kurute ca viḍaṃvatāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śabdabrahma paraṃ brahma mama bho śāśvatī tanuḥubhayaṃ ca mayāvyāptaṃ mayi caivo bhayaṃ sthitaṃsarvendriya guṇābhāsaṃ calate yena vigrahaṃtanmūrtayaḥ suniṣṇāna parabrahmādi gacchatina hi mokṣaphalantena janmakoṭi śatairapiśṛṣṭikarmaṇi kiṃ mokṣa bhavate vīravanditemandabuddhi savijñeyo viphalā tasya vāsanāsārātsāraṃ na jānanti māyayā bhramitāstutesa eva puruṣo hyātmā prakṛtīstha svarūpa dhṛksarvabhāvasthitonantaḥ saguṇaḥ sopi kīrtitaḥtenedamāvṛtaṃ viśvaṃ vitastimadhi tiṣṭatievaṃ virājaḥ pratipatya tatyaṃta vrīhiḥ pumānvibhajannātmanātmānāṃ ekadhā daśadhā tridhāadyovatāro ye nāsau bhūtagrāmau vibhāvyatevirāṭa savidhaḥ prāṇa ekadhā hṛdayena tutasya pūjā prakartavyā prāṇāpānena niścalāetat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ saguṇārādhanaṃ priyekāṃkṣibhiḥ paramaṃ tatvaṃ kartavyaṃ śivapūjanaṃtathā mokṣaphalaṃ divyaṃ labhate nātrasaṃsayaḥtasmāt parāt paronantaḥ pūjanīyo guṇatribhiḥprāṇāyāmena kartavyā kuleśaṃ yoga lakṣaṇāttayā mokṣaphalaṃ nāsti jñātavyaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥśāśvataṃ mānitaṃ yena sa mūrkho gajavannaraḥcintayet prāṇaliṃgantu somarūpamudāhṛtaṃkṛtrimaṃ naśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ prāṇaliṃgaṃ kathaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānaliṃgaṃ tu kutasteṣāmajñānāvṛtacetasāṃpratyakṣaṃ sarvagaṃ śuddhaṃ dṛśyate na ca lakṣyatedhāraṇā kīdṛśī sā tu procyate vṛṣabhadhvajaḥdhāraṇāt tasya vijñeyā dvādaśānte dhvanisthitāhṛdaye ca tathā kaṃṭhe bhruvormadhye varānanedvādaśānte prāṇaliṃgaṃ jīvapuṣpeṇa pūjayetsatasāhasra lakṣaikaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā samarcayetlakṣaṃ caivāntare proktaṃ śivaṃ sarve svarātmakaṃkathate dhyātma śāstreṣu muktaye lakṣasaṃjñakaṃekamātro dvimātraśca trimātrau vai japaḥ smṛtaḥpūjake śatasaṃkhyā ca sahasraṃ kuṃbhake tathāevaṃ japaḥ smṛto dehe pāpapuṇyakṣayaṃkaraḥeṣajāpyavidhiryoge aghoraḥ kathito mayāyo vai brahmavido loke jānaṃti paramaṃ śivaṃkṛta tretādvāpareṣu vahavo dhyātva cittamābrahmaviddurlabhaṃ loke guptarūpeṇasaṃsthitāḥlabdhamāṃ mānuśīṃ yonīṃ jñānavijñānasaṃbhavāṃātmā tu yena vijñāto deśikaḥ sotra kīrtitaḥyonveṣya piṇḍamadhye tu svātmaliṃgaṃ sadoditaṃbrahmacārī dīkṣataśca vānaprastha satāpasaḥvarṇāśramānāṃ yo dharmaḥ sadharmaḥ kathito mayābhaktiḥ priyā tapodānaṃ dīkṣāśvāsa nivartanaṃprāṇāyāma paroyogī sopi viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥavajñā yogayuktasya āyuḥ puṇyakṣayaṃkarīanantamahimā yogī yogābhyāsena jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sākāropi nirākāro dehī cābhyāsa yogataḥnānācāryaṃ matai yoga sa yogaḥ śiva jīvayoḥgranthavistāraṇārthāya procyatenekadhā priyerahasyaṃ sarvayogasya nānādarśanasaṃmataṃasmin śāstre mahāgopyaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ priyetatkarmacchedane jñānaṃ prādhānya svātmanaḥ paraṃye komārgaḥ prasiddhoyaṃ nirdhāraḥ prāṇasaṃyamaḥnānyaḥ paṃthāstu yogasya mārutena vinānaghevedaśāstrasya sāmyaṃ ca lokasyoddhāraṇāya caakulāgamanāmedaṃ śāstraṃ tena na nirmitaṃādikalpamahāviṣṇuḥ mama pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥmayā sarvaṃ śṛtaṃ devi parabrahma prasādataḥtacchāstramadhunā proktaṃ guptaṃ kuru maheśvarīteṣāṃ jñānaṃ tadātavyaṃ mamājñāṃ saṃsmaret priyebhaviṣyati kalosaṃkhyā tasmin kāle mahesvaraḥprāṇīnāṃ kṛpayā deva jñānaṃ vistārayaṃ prabhotatrāhaṃ dvijarūpeṇa kathayāmya kulāgamaṃaneka svātmano jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati kalau yugejñānasya mahimā vede aprameyo hyagocaraḥnābhi hṛtkaṇṭhadeveśa bhrūvilānte kulesthitaṃsopi yogī samākhyāto jīvanmukteti viśrutāḥprāṇāyāmaṃ vinābhadre dehapāto bhaviṣyatianyomārgo na tasyāsti sarvaśāstrasya saṃmataḥakulāgamasarvasvametat tvaṃ hṛdaye kuruantarniyamamārgeṇa madhyamena kulaṃ vaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00503 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: proktaṃ cākulanāthena sokulaḥ kulavarjitaḥtenedaṃ racitaṃ śāstraṃ vaṃdhavicchedakārakaṃkasyāpi hi na vaktavyaṃ vaktavyaṃ dharmaśālināṃśuddhānāṃ śodhanaṃ nāsti nirlepādbrahmavittamānāsti yoga paraṃ dhyānaṃ nāsti yogāt paraṃ sukhaṃbhavanāśaḥ sa vijñeya mārutasya kule gatiḥabhyāsācca svayaṃ prāṇo gacchate vyomamaṇḍalaṃguruprasādāt jñātavyaṃ rahasyaṃ hyakulāgamecaturāśramādikathanaṃ nāma navamaḥ paṭalaḥmama śatru vināsāya akulāya namostute
